valueMarkdown.value: This example of a IE Core Observation Clinical Result Profile illustrates its use to capture information about a patient's radiology study findings.

div.style: display: inline-block; background-color: #d9e0e7; padding: 6px; margin: 4px; border: 1px solid #8da1b4; border-radius: 5px; line-height: 60%
div.p: Profile: IE Core Observation Clinical Result Profile

value: LINES AND TUBES: None.
 LUNGS AND PLEURA:
 Clear lungs. Normal pulmonary vascularity.
 No pleural effusion.
 No pneumothorax.
 HEART, MEDIASTINUM AND HILA:
 Heart is normal in size.
 Normal mediastinal and hilar contour.
 BONES AND SOFT TISSUES:
 No acute abnormality.
